pry.e: Raccoons managed to pry the lid off the garbage pail.
pry.m: To move or force, especially in an effort to get something open.

prying.e: Raccoons managed to pry the lid off the garbage pail.
prying.m: To move or force, especially in an effort to get something open.

pryingly.e: 'Do you have a boyfriend,' she asked her prospective tenant pryingly.
pryingly.m: In a curious and prying manner.

pryings.m: A form of prying, as in “she pryings”. prying: to move or force, especially in an effort to get something open.
